name: plugin_compare

configurable_fields.url_column1: First URL column to compare (default: walmart_url)
configurable_fields.url_column2: Second URL column to compare (default: comparison_url)
configurable_fields.columns_to_compare: Explicit list of two columns to compare
configurable_fields.attributes_column1: Column containing JSON attributes for product 1 (enables attribute comparison mode)
configurable_fields.attributes_column2: Column containing JSON attributes for product 2 (enables attribute comparison mode)
configurable_fields.compare_method: Comparison method: exact_match or similarity (default: similarity)
configurable_fields.title_similarity_cutoff: Title similarity threshold for string comparison (default: 0.8)
configurable_fields.output_path: Override output file path (auto-generated if omitted)

description: Universal comparison plugin - compare any two URL columns
